text:
ellie: Heads-up — product wants a formal 'compat shim' flow for model swaps. Goal: let customers pin to older behavior while we migrate, and have clear launch gates + rollback signals. Need proposal by EOD Thur.

sam: +1. can we codify thresholds? e.g. perf regressions >5% or quality drop on core evals = rollback?

mike: prefer split signals: latency/cost and qualitative regressions. latency/cpu >10% or 95p latency > target => automated rollback. quality regressions use eval suite + customer-provided golden prompts.

tara: customer opt-in UX: allow tenant-level pin TTL and a "compat mode" header. they can opt into gradual deprecation notifications. also need billing implications documented.

jason: ops question — how do we route traffic for canary? suggestion: 3-tier canary: 1% internal test, 5% staged customers, 20% broader opt-in customers, then ramp. fallback should hit pinned variant in same region.

ellie: agree. add a 'shim' variant naming convention: model@compat-v{n} and metadata: previous_model, diff_summary, known_issues. That helps console and API.

sam: can we automate evaluation with these steps: 1) run perf benchmark on representative token lengths 2) run core eval set + customer prompts 3) run hallucination/regression checks 4) run cost estimate. If any step fails per threshold => gate fail.

mike: include KV cache compatibility check for stateful chat sessions. if cache keys differ we must provide a migration shim or force cold-start with clear warning.

deploy-bot: deploy started: compatibility-canary/2001234567 -> staging (1%). ETA 10m.

tara: require launch doc with these sections: success metrics (latency, p50/p95, cost delta, eval pass rate), rollback criteria, customer comms plan, telemetry keys, and opt-in UI copy. Assign owner for each.

ellie: action items: Sam -> draft thresholds + eval script by Wed AM; Mike -> routing/fallback runbook + KV shim feasibility by Wed PM; Tara -> customer opt-in UX + billing notes by Thu EOD; Jason -> canary rollout schedule + infra quotas by Wed. I'll assemble launch doc and schedule a 30m review Thur.

mike: small note — add a debug header for recording sample requests for reg checks: `X-Compat-Dump: true` (opt-in).

ellie: thanks team. if anyone has blockers ping me. :thumbsup:
